title: When the battle around you intensifies… that’s when the purpose inside you awakens.
paragraphs:
When the battle around you intensifies… that’s when the purpose inside you awakens.
You weren’t built to break.
You were built to rise, stand, and shine in the very place the enemy hoped you’d fall.
Your story is not ending — it’s beginning.
“The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.” – Exodus 14:14
